headline: Discover Autumn Charm in Bethel, Connecticut
subhead: Historic downtown streets, scenic parks, and easy rail connections in Greater Danbury.
caption: Bethel in October offers rich autumn colors and a walkable atmosphere. Along Greenwood Avenue, historic storefronts, local eateries, and independent shops anchor the downtown district. Outdoor spaces like Meckauer Park and nearby Putnam Memorial State Park provide scenic walking trails and seasonal foliage. Commuters benefit from the downtown Metro-North train station connecting along the Danbury Branch, alongside straightforward access to Route 6 and Interstate 84. From visiting the P.T. Barnum statue outside the Bethel Public Library to exploring local autumn farm markets, the town combines historic character with everyday convenience. Thinking about moving to Bethel? Reach out today to start your home search.
